title: Prop sizing of the futures book: challenge vs funded risk, chosen on 2010-22 bootstrap, checked on 2023-26
firm: same ASSUMED 50k swing firm as the overview (6% target, 4% EOD trailing locking at start, no daily limit, 90% split, $150 fee, payouts every 14 days)
grid: challenge scale {0.33, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0} x funded scale {0.25, 0.33, 0.5} (x 15% vol)
selection: maximise mean net 2-year P&L subject to P(profit) >= 0.85, block bootstrap (500 paths, block 20) of the Gen190 book 2010-06..2022-12
evaluation: chosen pair on a bootstrap of 2023-01..2026-09 only, vs the overview default (0.5 / 0.5)
